rows.en: From now on, would you team up with us?
...Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
We need your strength.
...But once we get the Pass back from that bastard,
we're saying bye-bye to this world, y'know? You still okay with that?
You still okay with that?
Yes. For now, we're only thinking about defeating the enemy in front of us.
Well, if you're counting on me that much, I've got no reason to say no.
Can't be helped! I, the great Momotaros, will lend you a hand!!
Kamen Rider Den-O joined the party!
Thank you, Den-O.
You bet!
What is it? You've got something you want to show me?
{8074} and the team handed over the "Broken Permidar Drill."
A drill...
Oh... A drill, huh?
What!? ...Granzairas is our opponent!?
...What? Our next opponents are the Over Flags?
An elite squad of Over Flags... Also known as the anti-Gundam investigation unit...
I don't want to cause you any trouble. I'll go.
Whoa whoa whoa...!! Hold on a sec!
Think you can hog all the glory for yourself? Not a chance!!
00, I understand how you feel, but they're our common enemy now. Please don't act alone.
Please don't act alone.
...Our next opponent is Jashrine!?
Yeah.
They're notorious villains who've been ravaging the universe.
I've heard they gather up the opponents they defeat and turn them into golden statues.
Apparently Shiomaneking is among our next opponents.
You know of Shiomaneking, Rider 1?
The bubbles he spews set anything they touch on fire... He's a fearsome foe...
...So our next opponent is Mururoa.
It's a kaiju that hates light, but put another way, that makes it extremely strong in the dark.
How much time had passed...? When they woke up, they were back at base.
...Looks like you've finally recovered.
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
...!! We were... if I recall...
You were found collapsed and rescued by Jack and Ace, who had gone out searching.
That squares our debt with you.
It just so happened that this time, we were the ones doing the rescuing.
But those were some terrible wounds. What on earth happened?
Zero told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Mebius told them what had happened inside the Cube.

Den-O told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Nu Gundam told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Zeta Gundam told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Wing Zero told them what had happened inside the Cube.
00 told them what had happened inside the Cube.
...I see. So Belial has finally shown himself.
Every kind of "evil" has gathered in this world... So it's no surprise that Belial is here too.
That being the case, Belial's appearance was only natural.
We must quickly regain our true power too. As we are, we'll struggle to fight through what lies ahead.
Belial said he stole the Plasma Spark, but it seems the Land of Light isn't completely dead.
In other words, that's proof the flame of the energy core still remains.
Makes sense. Sounds like that could be possible.
Of course... That certainly is a possibility.
I see. That certainly is a possibility.
I see. That certainly is a possibility.
I see... Then there's still hope!
I see... So there's still hope, huh?
I see...! So there's still hope!!

notes.note: Extracted labels for 0904 are shifted. Script (MessWinSet +N plays id N-1 in this table; confirmed by OkWin +9/+27 = 'Obtained Denden Sensor'/'Den-O joined'): #0.13,#0.14,#0.16,#0.18,#0.22,#0.28 = Nu Gundam; #0.15,#0.17,#0.19-21,#0.23,#0.24,#0.29 = Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros).
#0.19-#0.22 are not played by the script (it jumps +19 -> +24). Translated anyway as Momotaros (#0.19-21) / Nu Gundam (#0.22). 'That bastard' = Negataros, who stole the Pass (story_007).
Dropped subject restored as 'we' (Nu Gundam answering for the team); 'I' is also possible. Unplayed row.
Ore-sama rendered as 'I, the great Momotaros' (name added for the boast).
Item name per glossary: Permidar Drill; format follows the earlier 'Broken Zeroliner Drill' handover line.
Unplayed duplicate of the end of #0.6 (Zoffy).
Jashrine is a trio, so 'they' (glossary g=m, but plural group).
Shiomaneking referred to as 'he' per glossary g=m.

Leader variants follow Pt_Chara_Check order 15,14,12,11,5,4,2,1,3,6,7,9,10: #0.4 Zero, #0.5 Mebius, #0.6 Seven, #0.7 Ultraman, #0.8 OOO, #0.9 W, #0.10 Black RX, #0.11 Rider 1, #0.12 Den-O, #0.13 Nu Gundam, #0.14 Zeta Gundam, #0.15 Wing Zero, #0.16 00. Same order for #0.22-34 and #0.43-55. #0.5 uses boku vs ore elsewhere; identical in English. Wording matches the parallel scene in MainEventMess0403 (story_068/069).
Variants addressed to Zoffy: #0.43 Zero (casual), #0.44 Mebius, #0.45 Seven, #0.46 Ultraman (polite), #0.47 OOO, #0.48 W, #0.49 Black RX.

report: 80/80 rows. 0904 extracted labels shifted; speakers re-derived from the event script (see notes). Unplayed rows translated with inferred speakers: 0904 #0.19-22, 0905 #0.3, 0907 #0.7, 0911 #0.39. No new names.
